chunks: Ali ibn Ibrahim, from Muhammad ibn Isa, from Yunus, from Ibn Ra'ab, from Hanan ibn Sadeer, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:

I asked him (peace be upon him) about a man who was immoral with a Christian woman, so she gave birth to a boy from him. He acknowledged him, then died, and did not leave any child other than him. Would he inherit him? He (peace be upon him) said: Yes.

key_terms.فَجَرَ: To be immoral or have illicit relations

ai.seo_question: Does a son born from a Christian mother inherit from his Muslim father if acknowledged?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi clarifies that a son born to a Muslim father and a Christian mother inherits fully upon acknowledgment, reflecting the Shia principle that the father's religion determines the child's status for inheritance purposes. It highlights the legal weight of 'iqrar' (acknowledgment) in establishing lineage and rights, even in the absence of other heirs. This ruling underscores the practical application of nasab (lineage) in Shia jurisprudence, distinguishing it from mere biological descent.
